widgets.title: Web transactions time
nrql:
SELECT
  filter(average(apm.service.overview.web * 1000), WHERE segmentName LIKE 'Python') AS 'Python',
  filter(average(apm.service.overview.web * 1000), WHERE segmentName LIKE 'Postgres') AS 'Postgres',
  filter(average(apm.service.overview.web * 1000), WHERE segmentName LIKE 'ODBC') AS 'ODBC',
  filter(average(apm.service.overview.web * 1000), WHERE segmentName LIKE 'Web external') AS 'Web external'
FROM Metric
WHERE (
  ({{env}} = 'prod' AND entity.guid = '<REDACTED_BLOB>')
  OR ({{env}} = 'staging' AND entity.guid = '<REDACTED_BLOB>')
  OR ({{env}} = 'dev' AND entity.guid = '<REDACTED_BLOB>')
)
LIMIT MAX
SINCE 1800 seconds AGO
TIMESERIES

SELECT average(apm.service.transaction.duration * 1000) AS 'Response time' FROM Metric WHERE (entity.guid = '<REDACTED_BLOB>') AND (transactionType = 'Web') LIMIT MAX SINCE 1800 seconds AGO TIMESERIES
